helpPage.title: Need help using {{platform}}?
helpPage.intro: Here is how it works, step by step.

advertise.heading: How to advertise your skills
advertise.step3: Add your area and contact number.
advertise.step5: Your telephone number stays private until you approve someone's request.

find.heading: How to find someone
find.step1: Search for the help you need.
find.step4: The service provider decides whether to share their number.
find.step5: If they accept, the Call and WhatsApp options will appear in My Profile.

stuck.heading: Still stuck?
stuck.body: If you cannot create an account or publish your listing, you can ask a person for help.
stuck.placeholder: Support contact details will be published here shortly. In the meantime, please use the contact page.
